name: @local/dsh-observational-memory
description: Observational memory for long Harness sessions: background Observer/Reflector agents distil the conversation into a durable observation ledger, and compaction renders that ledger deterministically instead of re-summarizing the past.

meta.title: 观察记忆 / Observational memory
meta.description: 长会话的观察记忆：后台 Observer / Reflector 把对话蒸馏成持久观察账本，压缩时零模型调用地确定渲染，并可用 recall 按 id 回溯源证据。
